It is here that the evil lord [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] builds his bastion of power, which threatens the very existence of the [[Goddess of Truth]].}} {{Quotation|[[gw.dat]]|The Gate of Anguish is one of the great locks erected by the five gods to imprison Abaddon. Located on the first layer of the Realm of Torment, the lock was sundered when Varesh performed her unholy ceremony at the Temple of Lyssa in Vabbi, allowing the fallen lord to coalesce part of his godform and gain much greater control over his prison. Past the gate lies a whirpool of darkness.}} The [[Gate of Anguish]] is the staging area where the remnant forces of Abaddon retreated to after his defeat at the hands of the [[Order of the Sunspears]]. It is filled with what appears to be [[Harvestman's Lair|the remains of dead insectoid gods]] used to line the back of giant torsos that appear to be from the [[Domain of Pain]]. ==Getting there== This outpost can only be reached after completion of ''[[Guild Wars Nightfall]]'' [[campaign]] (that is, the [[Abaddon's Gate]] mission). Go to the [[Chantry of Secrets]] and talk to the [[Guardian of Whispers]] to enter the small gated area. In there, /[[Emote|kneel]] before the statue of the [[Goddess of Truth]] and talk to the [[Seer of Truth]] that appears. After entering Gate of Anguish in this way, it becomes available as a mission outpost on the [[Realm of Torment]] map. ==Quests available== *[[Chaplain Phyratyss]] **[[Finding a Purpose]] *[[High Priest Zhellix]] **[[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)|Mallyx the Unyielding]] (Difficulty: Master) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{me}} 20 [[High Priest Zhellix]] *{{x}} 20 [[Aurus Trevess]] *{{x}} 20 [[Chaplain Phyratyss]] *{{x}} 20 [[Raukus]] *{{x}} 20 [[Runahs Silus]] *{{x}} 20 [[Virashak]] ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Armorsmith of Whispers]] ([[hero armorer]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Dahn]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Deacon of Whispers]] ([[collector]] for 1 [[Armbrace of Truth]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Keeper of Whispers]] (collector for a set of [[:Category:Domain of Anguish gemstones|Domain of Anguish gemstones]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ==Notes== *There are no [[henchmen]] services here, since they cannot be taken into the elite [[explorable area]]s.
